maintenance_mode.description: Global maintenance switch to display maintenance banner and pause new submissions.

donation_gap_days_male.description: Enforced minimum days between whole blood donations for male donors.

donation_gap_days_female.description: Enforced minimum days between whole blood donations for female donors.

enable_sms_broadcasts.description: Flag to permit outbound SMS notifications to matching donors.

max_active_requests_per_seeker.description: Anti-spam rate limit: maximum open requests an individual seeker can have.

max_fundraisers_per_applicant.description: Maximum total active medical fundraisers allowed per verified applicant.

four_eyes_payout_threshold_bdt.description: Threshold in BDT above which two independent finance approvers are mandatory.

platform_fee_percent.description: Platform fee on medical donations (0% default, zero-profit model with optional voluntary tip).
